safetyCenter.title: Safety center
safetyCenter.intro: Travel Buddy is about meeting people on your own terms. These tips help you stay safe, at home and on the road.

meeting.title: Meeting other travellers
points: Meet in busy public places, in daylight when you can.
Tell a friend where you're going and who you're meeting.
Arrange your own transport and keep your phone charged.
You can leave at any time. Trust your instincts.

location.title: Your location
points: Discovery only ever shows the city you're in, never your exact position, and it's off until you turn it on.
Don't share your accommodation or exact address until you trust someone.
You can stop discovery or make your profile private at any time in Settings.

scams.title: Scams to watch for
points: Never send money or gift cards to someone you met in the app.
Be careful with links that ask you to pay or sign in outside the app.
Challenge prizes never cost anything. Anyone asking you to pay for a prize is not from Travel Buddy.

reporting.title: Reporting and blocking
points: Report a profile, story, comment, message, group or challenge from its menu.
Our team reviews every report, the most serious first. The person isn't told who reported them.
Blocking hides you from each other everywhere: profiles, stories, messages, trips and groups.

emergency.title: In an emergency
points: Call the local emergency number first: 112 works across the EU and in many other countries; 911 in the US and Canada.
Travel Buddy can't send help. After you're safe, report what happened so we can act on the account.
Keep your embassy's contact details with you when you travel abroad.
